findings.problem: a row-backed .tdd-unfrozen line is written with no prompt but read as a whole-file exemption whenever the record is invalid (detached HEAD, other branch, git timeout, record absent after merge); ship step 4's removal of applied entries is prompt-only and drop_record runs after the commit/push/PR, so a pass that skips step 4 ships a live line onto the default branch, unfreezing the file for every later pass (and worktree copies via substring match). Fix: an id-carrying line never falls back to a whole-file exemption, or the commit path refuses a live row-backed line / comment_row_lines runs before the commit.

a main-tree row line also matches .claude/worktrees/<w>/<same path> by substring; in a worktree with no rows for that file freeze_rows has exits 1 and the hook exits 0 (whole-file exemption) while the main record is valid; mirror tdd_py_lib.py:450
refused config keys omit submodule.recurse: with it true the no-prompt push also pushes submodule commits to their own remotes

the record's `at` is never read: base-mode validity stays true as the base advances; an abandoned pass or a PR opened another way leaves rows mode and no-prompt .tdd-unfrozen writes active into the next pass (contradicts docs/specs/loop-to-pr.md:28)

post_ask falls back to tool_input.answers (model-settable); research measured answers in tool_response, so the fallback is dead code and only the PreToolUse deny (no onFailure block) stands; drop the fallback
barrier checks rule types only (an admin bypass actor still counts) and barrier/base_ok are snapshots taken at the gate; no path within this pass
by design (## Gate): 4bis-PR publishes the commits and pr-body.md written after the go with no human view first; only the git add secret check filters content
